claims.summary: Observed: scan_known_model_control_markers (L114) reconstructs a remainder by filtering known markers, preserving a marker when it has valid delimiter reference syntax (L129-131) or is followed by an allowlisted relational verb like represents/denotes (L64-86).
claims.disposition: Verified from complete source at SHA 902a0358 and passing tests. Preservation is unified through reference_syntax() (L49-60): the delimiter path exact_reference_delimiter_syntax (L199) is checked first, then the relational-verb path (L64-86); L129 keeps the token when either yields Some. Her OR is substantively right. scan_known_model_control_markers_preserves_grouped_and_explicit_relation_contexts (tests.rs L2845) asserts both contexts.

claims.summary: Likely Snag: first_word_after (L89-96) might fail to identify a relational verb when separated by complex punctuation/symbols not covered by is_alphanumeric, or if a multi-word phrase is collapsed into one token.
claims.disposition: Refuted by complete source + tests; concern preserved. split_whitespace never collapses words; trim_matches(non-alnum except _) strips punctuation; find(!empty) takes the first real word. scan_known_model_control_markers_grounds_first_word_after_punctuation_boundary (L2900) proves a punctuation-separated verb still preserves the marker; control_marker_cleanup_uses_only_the_first_finite_relation_word (L2565) covers multi-word. Empty only when no alnum word follows (fail-closed).

claims.summary: Likely Snag: the scan loop's single-character fallback advance (L134-140) could cause inefficient scanning or unexpected fragmentation of adjacent tokens.
claims.disposition: Verified from source; no correctness defect. On no-marker at offset the loop copies one char to the remainder and advances by char.len_utf8() (byte-exact, UTF-8 safe; L134-140), faithfully reconstructing non-marker bytes with no fragmentation. control_marker_scanner_advances_byte_exactly_across_multibyte_text (L2099) proves byte-exact advance; ..._removes_adjacent_mixed_markers_without_rewriting_remainder (L1795) proves the remainder is not rewritten. Cost is bounded, not a bug.

claims.summary: One Test Each #1 (Contextual Preservation): a known marker inside brackets, e.g. [SYSTEM_PROMPT_A], should be preserved in the remainder because exact_reference_delimiter_syntax classifies [ and ] as GroupedExactKnownToken (L177-193).
claims.disposition: Behavior verified and already tested. The grouped-delimiter branch (L175-193) returns GroupedExactKnownToken and L129 preserves the token. scan_known_model_control_markers_preserves_grouped_and_explicit_relation_contexts (L2845) uses [<end_of_turn>] and asserts context==GroupedExactKnownToken; ..._preserves_exact_tokens_in_declared_group_delimiters (L2151) and the depth-two double-bracket test (L2876) also cover it. Proposed test already exists.

claims.summary: One Test Each #2 (Relational Verb): [TOKEN_X] behaves should make followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation (L64-86) return true and preserve the marker.
claims.disposition: Preserved and tested; contradiction preserved: with brackets, reference_syntax() checks the delimiter path FIRST (L50) and returns GroupedExactKnownToken, so followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation is never consulted for a bracketed marker (preserved via delimiter, not verb). The verb path (behaves allowlisted L69) is proven on a BARE marker: scan_known_..._contexts (L2858) asserts <end_of_turn> behaves as... -> ExplicitExactKnownTokenRelation.

claims.summary: Suggested Next: verify the exhaustive KNOWN_MODEL_CONTROL_MARKERS list (referenced L102) so longest_exact_known_model_control_marker_at handles overlapping markers (e.g. COMMAND vs COMMAND_EXEC).
claims.disposition: Overlap handling verified. longest_exact_known_model_control_marker_at uses .max_by_key(|t| t.len()) (L106): the longest starts_with match wins. The actual list (fallback_contracts.rs L159-180) has no COMMAND tokens (hypothetical, NOT_FOUND) but has real overlaps: <channel|> inside thought <channel|>, and [INST]/[/INST]. control_marker_cleanup_uses_longest_raw_matches_with_exact_accounting (L1745) and ..._preserves_longest_overlapping_token... (L2453) prove longest-match.
